mantras.0: You doubt yourself, yet secretly many admire your progress. Stop being your own harshest critic.
mantras.1: Feeling like an impostor because you're not an expert yet? It's not a sign of weakness. It means you dared to step into a room bigger than your comfort zone.
mantras.2: Your level has gone up, but mentally you still feel like you're at level one. Acknowledge today's achievements, no matter how small.
mantras.3: Being smart doesn't mean never being confused. It means having the courage to keep seeking answers even when you feel like the dumbest person in the room.
mantras.4: This room might feel too big for you right now. But that's okay, soon you will grow to fill every corner of it.
mantras.5: Having too many paths makes you stand still. Close your eyes, pick one skill today. Getting lost while trying is much better than freezing at the starting line.
mantras.6: Your head is too noisy thinking about next year's worst-case scenarios. Take a breath. Your only job today is to finish what is right in front of you.
mantras.7: You panic because the final destination isn't visible yet. But did you realize? The small steps you take every day are automatically paving that path.
mantras.8: Don't let an unwritten future steal today's peace. Complete one small task, then rest.
mantras.9: The failure scenarios in your head are just fiction. In reality, you are much tougher than you imagine.
mantras.10: No one sees how many times you repeated, deleted, and tried again last night. But believe me, those quiet nights are what will mold you into an expert.
mantras.11: You're tired because today's efforts didn't yield instant results. Don't be fooled. A strong foundation is always built underground, invisible at first.
mantras.12: Sometimes it feels very lonely struggling alone to understand something new. But remember, the deadliest weapons are always forged in silent rooms.
mantras.13: Your computer screen is the silent witness to how many times you refused to give up. Be proud of that persistence.
mantras.14: The final result is what's displayed to the world, but the messy behind-the-scenes process is what truly matures you.
mantras.15: Constantly peeking at other people's screens will only make you blind to your own map. You are not behind, you are carving your own shortcut.
mantras.16: Anxious seeing those who have soared far ahead? They have their own cheat codes, and you have your own tricks. Don't use someone else's ruler to measure your success.
mantras.17: Being envious of their final results is human. But you forget, you never saw how broken they were when they first started.
mantras.18: Blooming at a different time doesn't mean you failed to bloom. Your time will come when your roots are ready.
mantras.19: They run fast on a track. You are climbing a mountain. Of course your speeds are different. Just enjoy the climb.
mantras.20: You are waiting for the '100% ready' moment that will never arrive. Just jump. You will learn how to land while you're falling.
mantras.21: Afraid of choosing the wrong role or skill? The biggest mistake isn't picking the wrong path, it's not having the courage to choose at all.
mantras.22: Behind every fear of starting, there is a future version of you who is thankful that today you dared to press the start button.
mantras.23: The 'start' button is indeed the hardest to press. But believe me, once pressed, your greatest fear has been surpassed.
mantras.24: It is far better to fail from trying to step forward, than to regret spending your whole life watching from the sidelines.
mantras.25: If today feels too heavy, just surviving and closing your eyes is also a victory. Rest, tomorrow we start again.
mantras.26: Even the most advanced systems need a restart. You are human, not a machine. Allow yourself to rest without guilt.
mantras.27: Crying when hitting a dead end is normal. Let it all out, then look at your screen again later with a clearer mind.
mantras.28: You don't have to know the answer right now. What's important is you're willing to find out. That is more than enough.
mantras.29: Your exam scores do not measure your worth. Believe that.
mantras.30: There are moments when you will feel this is too hard. That is exactly when your growth is happening.
mantras.31: The best teacher you've ever had is your own curiosity. Don't kill it.
mantras.32: It's not the smartest one who will succeed. It's the one most willing to learn.
mantras.33: Everyone you admire was once in the exact same position you are right now.
mantras.34: If today feels heavy, it's not a sign you are weak. It's a sign you are carrying something meaningful.
mantras.35: You are allowed to be scared. But stepping forward despite the fear, that's called bravery.
mantras.36: Mistakes are not your enemy. Mistakes are your best way to learn what isn't taught in any book.
mantras.37: Don't compare your chapter 1 to someone else's chapter 20.
mantras.38: The knowledge you gain today is something no one can ever take from you. Forever.
mantras.39: You are not wasting time. You are building the foundation that will later support everything.
mantras.40: A love for learning is not an innate talent. It is something you discover when you find the right thing.
mantras.41: One consistent small step beats a giant leap that only happens once.
mantras.42: You are more capable than you think. Seriously. People out there sometimes see it more clearly than you do.
mantras.43: Even vague dreams are worth fighting for. Later along the way, the map will become clearer.
mantras.44: Nothing you learn is ever wasted, even if it feels irrelevant right now.

docsContent.p_58: Welcome, Adventurer. You have just opened the gates to PathTrick's official documentation center.
docsContent.p_59: Imagine a student standing at an intersection. On the one hand there is a choice of major, on the other hand there is a scholarship, and then a career waiting at the end of the road. Every year, millions of Indonesian students stand at the same point, forced to decide on a direction long before they have time to recognize their own strengths. Maps were everywhere, but the road remained foggy. Assessment results stop as numbers, courses run independently, and a CV may not necessarily be able to prove what can really be done.
docsContent.p_60: In PathTrick, the fog turns into a path that you can walk on. Your journey starts from a RIASEC assessment or CV analysis, then branches into a learning roadmap, mission, project, and verifiable credentials. Everything unfolds in the world of RPG Pixel-Art, so that the first steps feel easy, progress looks real, and learning doesn't stop at a recommendation. Every quest you complete brings you closer to a demonstrable skill, not just a number on a dashboard.
docsContent.p_61: This story has three chapters. Start at <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('background')} style={linkStyle}>Background</button> to find out why this path was opened, go to <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('solution')} style={linkStyle}>Our Solution</button> to see how we answered it, then take a peek at <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('architecture')} style={linkStyle}>System Architecture</button> to see the engine behind the world.
docsContent.p_62: This story begins with something you may have seen often. Open timeline X (Twitter), and you will find complaints from students who feel they have "the wrong major". That's actually not surprising. Abroad, leading universities actually recommend that prospective students take a gap year to explore and discover their true interests and talents without pressure. In Indonesia, the story is different. We live by the "meter" of age: at 20 you have to be like this, at 25 you have to be like that. As a result, more than 50% of high school students are forced to choose a major in a hurry, without systematic guidance to accompany them in answering one of the most basic questions: "What am I really cut out to be?"
docsContent.p_63: Then they graduate. You might think the fog will clear, but the next hurdle is even tougher. The bitter truth is, 1.01 million university graduates are now unemployed nationwide, proof that a degree no longer guarantees a job. The youth unemployment rate (ages 15-24) has reached 16.89%, more than three times the national rate. Imagine, out of six young people lined up, one of them is looking for work and can't find it. Why does this happen? Because 46% of companies struggle to find candidates with the skills they need. As fresh graduates, they collide hard with a steep skill gap between academic theory and the harsh demands of the industry. Those who realize this begin competing to collect digital (Web2) course certificates to decorate their CVs. Unfortunately, such certificates are very easy to fake or duplicate. The value of an achievement slowly fades when its authenticity can no longer be proven with absolute certainty.
docsContent.p_64: Across the table, the recruiters were also running out of time and energy. They have no instant way to conclusively verify a candidate's portfolio and skills. Students need validation that is recognized, while recruiters need certainty that cannot be manipulated. Both are trapped in outdated and inefficient credential verification systems. It was at this saturation point that the idea for PathTrick began to be written - as a way out of the maze.
docsContent.p_65: So we build a world. PathTrick brings together the power of AI and Web3 (BNB Chain) in one gamification platform, and the journey within it takes place in three steps:
docsContent.p_66: In charge of welcoming new adventurers. Privy handles the Login process (using Email or Google account) and magically creates a crypto wallet (Embedded Wallet) behind the scenes without burdening users with having to install wallet extensions or storing complex secret passwords.
docsContent.p_67: Once a user has a wallet from Privy, the wallet and ethers provider takes over the heavy lifting. Both deliver instructions from the PathTrick screen directly to the Smart Contract on the BNB Chain, from reading certificate data to executing Soulbound Token printing. The mint flow continues to check the network, balance, mint price, receipt, and event contract before the certificate is confirmed to the backend.
docsContent.p_68: Let's get acquainted with The Dreamer. They are young souls in grades 10 to 12 whose eyes are still sparkling at the future, but whose minds are often filled with doubt. At this academic crossroads, they no longer need stacks of thick brochures or mere campus promises. They really need clear guidance, a concrete road map that can be immediately executed, and a pleasant spark of motivation to keep going without fear of going in the wrong direction.
docsContent.p_69: In contrast to The Dreamer, let's say hello to The Chaser. They are a line of heroes at the end of college or fresh graduates who are running fast to pursue their first career in the real world. At this stage, they no longer have time to guess the subject matter. They really need a proving ground where their skills can be sharpened, tested hard, and verified for absolute authenticity by industry recruiters.
docsContent.p_70: The persona profile is in <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('roles')} style={linkStyle}>User Roles</button>, the usage flow is in <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('flow')} style={linkStyle}>End-to-End Flow</button>.
docsContent.p_71: The persona profile is in <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('roles')} style={linkStyle}>User Roles</button>, the usage flow is in <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('flow')} style={linkStyle}>End-to-End Flow</button>.
docsContent.p_72: PathTrick's adventure hub is built on the foundation of Phaser.js, a powerful 2D game engine that lives right inside your browser. In this world, there are 10 Worlds (The 10 Worlds) whose division refers to the global education classification standard UNESCO ISCED-F 2013 (International Standard Classification of Education: Fields of Education and Training). Each World represents a main field of knowledge and stores crucial competency modules in it. When you first set foot, only the first World will open its doors for you. Subsequent worlds are closely guarded by the system and will only open after you have successfully proven your worthiness in the previous world.
docsContent.p_73: To make the whole adventure feel alive without any lag, we use a seamlessState Machinearchitecture. Your track record in each world is closely guarded by the Zustandmemory vault. When your character interacts in the game world, the game engine will directly whisper to the interface via special communication waves. At the same time, every drop of sweat, aka experience points, that you collect will be calculated instantly and beamed to your main screen that very second.
docsContent.p_74: RIASEC is not just an outdated psychological theory, but a powerful career compass created by Holland (1959). This magic compass divides the human personality into six main directions: Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, and Conventional. At PathTrick, we use this compass as the most solid foundation for reading the wind direction of a high school student's true potential, before they get lost in the jungle of lectures.
docsContent.p_75: At the end of this long ritual, AI presents you with a treasure box in the form of a narrative career profile that tells who you really are. In it there is a list of five recommendations for the most promising college majors, complete with the reasons why that major calls you. Not only that, this box also contains a list of targeted universities and their entry routes, a map of scholarships ready to fund your trip, and recommendations for which of the 10 Houses are most suitable for covering your weaknesses and honing your potential.
docsContent.p_76: Behind the scenes, the entire assessment process is carried out by Agent 1 (AGENT_1_DREAMER). This agent communicates with the Groq API using the Qwen 3.8-27b model with a low temperature (0.4) because this is a structured task, not a creative task. The AI ​​output is rigorously validated using a Zod Schema and a Guardrail system that ensures every university, major and scholarship ID reference is actually in the database. If the AI ​​fails or returns invalid data, the system falls into adeterministic fallbackthat still provides meaningful recommendations based on the available data.
docsContent.p_77: For adventurers who have reached Student and Fresh Graduate level (The Chaser persona), the RIASEC compass method is no longer relevant. They need more deadly weapons. Instead, Agent 2 (AGENT_2_CHASER) goes directly to the battlefield by analyzing their main weapon: Curriculum Vitae (CV). With its eagle eye, AI dissects all of these documents to detect what skill ammunition they already have, find where they are weak against the industry's tough standards, and finally reassemble a learning roadmap that is the most precise and efficient.
docsContent.p_78: CV Analyzer is run by Agent 2 (AGENT_2_CHASER) which also communicates with Groq API (Qwen 3.8-27b). To enrich its analysis, the system utilizes Cohere embed-multilingual-v3.0 (1024 dimensions) as an embedding engine for the Knowledge Base. Knowledge documents are stored in PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM, and similarity searches are carried out in-memory using cosine similarity. This RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technique ensures that AI recommendations are always relevant to the current industry context.
docsContent.p_79: Apart from that, Agent 3 (Essay Evaluator) is tasked with assessing project and essay answers from The Chaser. This agent uses very low temperatures (0.1) to ensure consistent and deterministic scoring. The results of this AI evaluation determine whether an adventurer is worthy of receiving a Soulbound Token as proof of graduation.
docsContent.p_80: Many Web3 platforms fail because they overwhelm users with complex technical terms from day one. PathTrick takes a very different path. Considering that most of our adventurous heroes are high school and college students in Indonesia who may not be familiar with the world of crypto, we designed the Crypto Invisible system. We deliberately hide all the complexities of blockchain behind the curtain of a user interface that is very friendly, warm and familiar to their eyes.
docsContent.p_82: BNB Smart Chain Testnet, Chain ID 97
docsContent.p_86: The current deployment is intended for demo and validation on the testnet. The value of tBNB has no real economic value, RPCs can experience delays, and certificate status remains dependent on backend availability. For production, PathTrick needs to add transaction monitoring, secure retry, indexing certificates, consent management, wallet recovery policies, and business decisions whether gas fees are still paid by users or subsidized by partners.
docsContent.p_87: In the world of traditional RPG gaming, the rarest and most powerful items usually have the "Soulbound" attribute - meaning, the weapon or armor is magically bound to the character who finds it and cannot be traded to other players.
docsContent.p_88: PathTrick adopts this philosophy into the real world. The certificate obtained after conquering a House is minted as a Soulbound Token (SBT) on the BNB Smart Chain. This means that the credentials permanently lock the achievements in the user's wallet. Cannot be transferred, cannot be sold, and cannot be stolen.
docsContent.p_89: As explained in the chapter <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo('background')} style={linkStyle}>Background</button>, one of the biggest problems for fresh graduates and recruiters today is that Web2 certificates (PDF/JPG) are very easy to manipulate with photo editing applications or copied by people who have never taken the course.
docsContent.p_90: SBT radically changes the evidentiary landscape. When a recruiter (The Chaser) sees a candidate's SBT badge on PathTrick, they no longer need to call the issuer to ensure its authenticity. This truth has been recorded by thousands of nodes in the blockchain network, providing trust without the need for intermediaries (Trustless Verification).
docsContent.p_91: Our system does more than simply slap a "Non-Transferable" label on the web interface (UI). This soulbound property is fully enforced mathematically at the Smart Contract level (adopting the modified BEP-1155 standard).
docsContent.p_92: Final verification is enforced through confirming the reading of *Transaction Receipt*, checking the CertificateMinted event, and permanent logging in explorers such as BscScan.
docsContent.p_93: PathTrick uses Privy for seamless authentication (email/Google) while also creating an embedded wallet. After a successful Privy login, the frontend exchanges the access token for an application-specific JWT from the backend.
docsContent.p_95: To start the journey, the user must pass an assessment which is processed directly by PathTrick's AI Agent. The POST /api/assessment route supports various types of payload depending on the user role.
docsContent.p_96: We will never keep your secret scroll (physical files). Once the contents are successfully copied, the original file is immediately melted into dust (deleted from the server). We only store the final results of AI analysis in a database vault. You are free to upload a new CV at any time, and AI will restore your career journey map in that instant without leaving a trace of old documents.
docsContent.p_97: PathTrick does not store passwords that are vulnerable to being stolen. We handed over gatekeeping duties to Privy, a leading Web3 identity provider. Every time you log in using Google, Email, or Wallet, our servers only receive a JWT token that proves that you are the rightful owner of the account. Your identity security is maintained at par with digital banking standards.
docsContent.p_98: AI that is too smart sometimes likes to make up stories (hallucinations). To prevent this, we install layered Guardrails (invisible fences) using Zod Schema and deterministic instructional prompts. If you enter fictitious data or attempt a Prompt Injection to confuse the AI, our system will automatically discard the spell and provide a safe standard response, ensuring the integrity of the game engine is maintained.
docsContent.p_99: All transactions that result in the creation of a certificate (SBT) are protected by EIP-712 Typed Signatures. This means, our Smart Contract will not accept random orders from outside. It will only move if the request carries a magic stamp (Digital Signature) printed directly by PathTrick's official backend. There is no way for hackers to "print fake certificates" by bypassing the application interface.
docsContent.bg_1: Open social media and search for "wrong major". Thousands of stories will appear from different campuses and cities, yet the pattern is always the same: it all starts with one big decision made too quickly. In many developed countries, prospective students are encouraged to take a gap year to discover their interests and talents, while in Indonesia that kind of pause is often seen as falling behind. At 18 you must be in college, at 22 you must graduate, at 23 you must already be working. Under that pressure, more than 50% of high school students choose their major in a rush, without ever being properly guided to answer one simple question: where do I actually belong?
docsContent.bg_2: That unanswered question doesn't disappear at graduation. Youth unemployment (ages 15-24) in Indonesia has reached 16.89%, more than three times the national rate. Picture six of your classmates applying for jobs; one of them goes home empty-handed. Even a bachelor's degree is no longer a safe ticket, as 1.01 million university graduates remain unemployed. Ironically, at the very same time, 46% of companies say they struggle to find candidates with the skills they need. The jobs exist, the job seekers exist, yet the two never meet because of the distance between what is taught in the classroom and what the working world truly needs.
docsContent.bg_3: Many fresh graduates try to close that gap by collecting online course certificates. Unfortunately, digital certificates are relatively easy to fake or duplicate, so every certificate becomes suspect, including those of genuinely competent candidates. On the other side of the table, recruiters face hundreds of CVs with no quick way to confirm which claims are real. Candidates need recognition that is trusted; recruiters need proof that cannot be manipulated. This is where PathTrick was born: a bridge connecting three points that have long been disconnected, discovering potential, building skills, and proving them.
docsContent.sol_intro: PathTrick combines AI and Web3 (BNB Chain) in a single gamified platform that guides two kinds of adventurers. They start from different places, so their paths are designed differently:
docsContent.sol_dreamer_tag: High school students still searching for direction
docsContent.sol_dreamer_s1_d: AI reads interests and personality through a RIASEC assessment, so the question "where do I belong?" finally gets an answer.
docsContent.sol_dreamer_s2_d: AI recommends a Learning Path from 10 Houses based on UNESCO ISCED-F 2013. Each House is conquered through a mini-project, not memorization.
docsContent.sol_dreamer_s3_d: Every completed House earns an SBT, a foundation for choosing a major with confidence.
docsContent.sol_chaser_tag: University students and fresh graduates chasing a career
docsContent.sol_chaser_s1_d: AI analyzes the CV and the target career field, then uncovers the skill gap between current abilities and industry needs.
docsContent.sol_chaser_s2_d: If a gap exists, AI recommends Skill Missions that target exactly the missing skills. No need to start from zero.
docsContent.sol_chaser_s3_d: Completed Skill Missions earn an SBT and make them eligible to apply to the companies and fields they are aiming for.
docsContent.sol_closing: On both paths, every achievement is recorded as a Soulbound Token (SBT) on BNB Chain, a permanent digital certificate that cannot be transferred or falsified. Users have undeniable proof, and recruiters can verify it directly on-chain. The trust problem that has long burdened both sides is solved by the design of the system itself.
